library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Filter data for Machine == 1
machine_1_data <- X027[X027$Machine == 1, ]

# Convert Pressure to a factor
machine_1_data$Pressure_f <- as.factor(machine_1_data$Pressure)

# Create the boxplot
p <- ggplot(machine_1_data, aes(x = Pressure_f, y = PartResistance, fill = Pressure_f)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Part Resistance by Pressure for Machine 1",
    x = "Pressure (kPa)",
    y = "Part Resistance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white")
  )

# Convert to plotly object
p_plotly <- ggplotly(p)

# Save the interactive plot as HTML
saveWidget(p_plotly, "media/plots/boxplot_machine_1_partresistance_by_pressure.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
